```yaml
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.14"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        run: uv python install ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Sync dev dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run pytest
        run: uv run pytest
```

yaml:
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.14"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        run: uv python install ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Sync dev dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run pytest
        run: uv run pytest
